verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online documents a human-driven reconciliation workflow: it imports bank transactions, auto-matches invoice payments, and produces reconciliation and discrepancy reports. Intuit Intelligence chat can 'help resolve anomalies', and the official MCP server exposes CRUD access and reports. None of this shows an agent reconciling a month end-to-end, flagging exceptions and preparing the close for human review. Those pieces are adjacent features or developer building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
